workload.durability: checksummed Raft files; fsync and atomic rename before acknowledgement

failover.metric: graceful leader stop to first successful committed HTTP PUT on a replacement leader

limitations: All nodes and clients run on one machine, so results do not include real network latency or independent disks.
Failover uses graceful process cancellation, not SIGKILL or power loss.
The throughput workload sends PUTs to the known leader and does not measure leader discovery or mixed reads.
